events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: The New York Giants will have to wait a while to make the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles prevent Giants from clinching playoff spot, 24-19

headlines.description: Jay Ajayi ran for 206 yards and broke loose for a 53-yarder in overtime to set up Andrew Franks' 27-yard field goal to lead the Miami Dolphins to a 34-31 win over the Buffalo Bills.
headlines.shortLinkText: Franks' field goal seals Dolphins' 34-31 OT win over Bills

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for a touchdown and ran for two more, and the Washington Redskins gave their fading playoff hopes a boost with a 41-21 victory over the Chicago Bears on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins leads way as Redskins pound Bears 41-21

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: The Browns are winless no more.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christmas gift: Browns get first win, beat Chargers 20-17

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw four touchdowns passes, Jordy Nelson shredded Minnesota's secondary for 154 yards and two scores, and the resurgent Green Bay Packers beat the Vikings 38-25 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Nelson shred Vikings as surging Packers win 38-25

events.name: New York Jets at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady three touchdowns passes, and the Patriots moved a step closer to securing home-field advantage throughout the AFC playoffs with a 41-3 win over the New York Jets on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots close in on AFC top seed with 41-3 win over Jets

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw two touchdowns passes, Tevin Coleman had 135 yards from scrimmage, and the Atlanta Falcons moved a step closer to winning the NFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan, Coleman lead Falcons past Panthers 33-16

headlines.description: Blake Bortles' best game of the season helped the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Tennessee Titans 38-17 on Saturday and end a nine-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Inspired Jaguars knock out Mariota, rout Titans 38-17

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw three touchdown passes in the second quarter before leaving the game in the fourth quarter with an injured right leg, putting a serious damper on the Oakland Raiders' 33-25 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr's injury puts damper on Raiders' 33-25 win over Colts

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw a 10-yard touchdown pass with 31 seconds left and scrambled for a go-ahead 2-point conversion and the San Francisco 49ers overcame a 14-point deficit to end a 13-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick, 49ers end 13-game skid with 22-21 win over Rams

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Mark Ingram rushed for two-touchdowns and a game-sealing first down in the final minutes, and the New Orleans Saints put a considerable damper on Tampa Bay's playoff aspirations with a 31-24 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Buccaneers playoff hopes take hit with 31-24 loss to Saints

headlines.description: The Arizona Cardinals continue to give the Seattle Seahawks headaches at home. This time, it will likely end up costing Seattle a first-round bye in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catanzaro's field goal gives Arizona 34-31 win over Seattle

headlines.description: Tom Savage threw for 176 yards in his first career start and the Bengals missed a field goal as time expired, giving the Texans a 12-10 victory and their second straight AFC South title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans clinch AFC South with 12-10 win over Bengals

headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers rode Ben Roethlisberger's right arm and Antonio Brown's left arm to the AFC North title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers win AFC North after rallying by Ravens 31-27

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: With their postseason spot secured, the Kansas City Chiefs turned to Travis Kelce and Tyreek Hill to roll past the Denver Broncos 33-10 on Sunday night and keep their AFC West title hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs rout Broncos 33-10 to keep AFC West title hopes alive

headlines.description: Dez Bryant threw his first career TD pass between a pair of scoring catches, Ezekiel Elliott ran for two TDs and the Dallas Cowboys kept Detroit from clinching a playoff spot with a 42-21 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryant, Cowboys keep Lions' playoff hopes on hold, 42-21
